description.value:
You gain one of the following features of your choice.

  • Death from the Dark. Once per turn, when you hit a creature you are hidden from with your natural weapons, you deal additional damage equal to two rolls of your Natural Weapons die and the target has to make a Wisdom Saving Throw.
  • The DC for this is 8 + your Proficiency + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). On a failure, the target is Frightened until the end of your next turn.
  • Evasive Flight. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity Saving Throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the Saving Throw, and only half damage if you fail.
  • If you succeed on the Saving Throw, you can use your Reaction to move up to half your Speed to an unoccupied space that you can see. If you are carrying an ally or otherwise moving them with you, they also automatically succeed on the Saving Throw and take no damage.
  • You don't benefit from this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition.
  • Concussive Impact. When you use Primal Pounce and hit the target, it has to make a Constitution Saving Throw. The DC for this is 8 + your Proficiency + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). On a failure, the target suffers an effect based on the distance you travelled as part of Primal Pounce. The listed effects are cumulative.
    • 20 feet or more: The target is knocked Prone.
    • 40 feet or more: The target is Dazed until the end of your next turn.
    • 60 feet or more: The target is Stunned until the end of your next turn.
